frames.title: A withheld signed order, relayed after revocation
frames.caption: A signed order is rejected 48 s before its deadline: the owner revoked the grant, and its signing key no longer exists.

frames.title: Let an AI agent trade within limits a contract enforces
frames.caption: How it got there: an AI agent trades within limits that a contract enforces.

frames.title: 1 · Grant and limits
frames.caption: The owner grants fixed limits on $1,899.80: at most 20% ($379.96) per order and 0.50% price concession.

frames.title: 2 · Reviewed in the console
frames.caption: In the console, read from the sandbox, the owner sees the grant active, its key registered on the verifier, and limits as granted.

frames.title: 3 · Bounded proposal and trade
frames.caption: A recorded claude-haiku-5-5 proposal sells 49.90 USDC for 16.5468 wNEAR, signed by the contract and filled exactly. USDC share: 52.63% to 50.01%, target 50%.

frames.title: 4 · Signed order withheld
frames.caption: A second order, 20.0000 wNEAR for 59.83 USDC, is signed but withheld. The verifier would still accept it.

frames.title: 5 · Hostile requests
frames.caption: 39 of 39 scripted hostile requests refused, nothing changed: local validation 10, contract method check 14, policy validation 4, agent key permission 10, verifier 1.

frames.title: 6 · Owner revocation
frames.caption: In the console, after an exact preview, the owner revokes via the local sandbox test signer (not a wallet); the key's removal is confirmed.

frames.title: 7 · Withheld order relayed
frames.caption: Another account relays the withheld order 48 s before its deadline. The verifier rejects it: the signing key no longer exists.

frames.title: 8 · Recovery to the owner's Intents account
frames.caption: With the oracle failing and the MPC double on hold, the owner recovers 950.10 USDC and 316.5468 wNEAR into its Intents account.

frames.title: 9 · Owner withdrawal to NEAR
frames.caption: Separately, outside recovery, the owner withdraws 950.10 USDC and 316.5468 wNEAR to its NEAR account, registering storage only where needed.

frames.title: Check it yourself
frames.caption: Sandbox run with labelled test doubles. Mainnet run pending approval; no mainnet transaction executed. Reproduce: make demo, make test.

frames.title: A bounded trading mandate on NEAR Intents
frames.caption: Claim: the contract builds and signs every trade; after confirmed key removal, withheld orders fail and the owner recovers without agent, oracle or signer.

frames.title: A bounded trading mandate on NEAR Intents
frames.caption: Certified for this demo: the latest certified acceptance run binds to this demo's clean revision, spec, fixtures and every deployed WASM.

frames.title: 1 · Grant and limits
frames.caption: The owner grants the mandate. Initial reference value: $1,899.80. Limits are fixed for the grant; the agent cannot change them.

frames.title: 2 · Mandate reviewed in the console
frames.caption: In the console, read from the sandbox, the owner sees the grant active, its key registered on the verifier, and limits as granted.

frames.title: 3 · Recorded genuine model output, claude-haiku-5-5
frames.caption: Recorded genuine model output, claude-haiku-5-5: sell 49.90 USDC for wNEAR, at most 50 bps concession. The contract signs it.

frames.title: 3b · Trade on the real verifier WASM
frames.caption: Our filler fills it on the pinned mainnet verifier WASM: the mandate pays 49.90 USDC and receives 16.5468 wNEAR, exactly as signed.

frames.title: 4 · A second signed order is withheld
frames.caption: A scripted second order, 1, is signed and withheld. Before revocation the verifier's simulation accepts this exact bundle.

frames.title: 5a · Attack log: local validation, 10 of 10 refused
frames.caption: Local validation: 10 hostile requests refused, each with no state change.

frames.title: 5b · Attack log: contract method check, 14 of 14 refused
frames.caption: Contract method check: 14 hostile requests refused, each with no state change.

frames.title: 5c · Attack log: policy validation, 4 of 4 refused
frames.caption: Policy validation: 4 hostile requests refused, each with no state change.

frames.title: 5d · Attack log: agent key permission, 10 of 10 refused
frames.caption: Agent key permission: 10 hostile requests refused, each with no state change.

frames.title: 5e · Attack log: verifier, 1 of 1 refused
frames.caption: Verifier: 1 hostile request refused, each with no state change.

frames.title: 6 · Owner revokes in the console; key removal confirmed
frames.caption: In the console, after an exact preview, the owner revokes via the local sandbox test signer (not a wallet); the key's removal is confirmed.

frames.title: 7 · The withheld order is relayed and rejected
frames.caption: Another account relays the withheld order 48 s before its deadline. The verifier rejects it: the key no longer exists.

frames.title: 8 · Ordinary recovery with agent, oracle and MPC unavailable
frames.caption: With the oracle failing and the MPC test double on hold, the owner recovers 950.10 USDC and 316.5468 wNEAR into its Intents account through ordinary recovery.

frames.title: 9 · Owner withdrawal to its NEAR account
frames.caption: Separately, outside recovery, the owner withdraws 950.10 USDC and 316.5468 wNEAR to its NEAR account, registering storage only where needed.

frames.title: Acceptance gates per case: 35 of 35 passed
frames.caption: 35 of 35 required cases passed, certified for this demo.

frames.title: Acceptance gates per case: 35 of 35 passed
frames.caption: The emergency owner-key rescue is reported separately; it never counts as ordinary recovery.
